title: Ciphered recipes on the last leaf of a Wolfenbüttel recipe book, HAB Cod. Guelf. 123 Blank., f. 59v (catalogue 3807): a metallurgical recipe (silver, lead, antimony, cupels) in Latin and German, read in part; key not validated on the held-out portion (contributed by Brice Dudout)

documents.shelfmark: Herzog August Bibliothek Wolfenbüttel, Cod. Guelf. 123 Blank., f. 59v (scan 00120)
documents.route: unknown (recipe book; writer or compiler unidentified)

plaintext.source: Butzmann, Die Blankenburger Handschriften, p. 131, notes the cipher without a reading; no decipherment found (catalogue 3807 vetting, 23 Nov 2026; DECODE, Tomokiyo, Lasry checked).

transcription.source: HAB digital library, diglib.hab.de/mss/123-blank (full-resolution files; licence not confirmed, no image in this folder)
transcription.notes: Two blind passes (blind/PASS-A.txt, PASS-B.txt) and a blind arbiter who had not seen the key on 38 discrepancies (prereg/frozen/transcription/ARBITREE.txt). 171 cipher words, about 930 signs; tokens counted are words.

system.summary: Simple substitution: vowels shifted one place (a>b e>f i>k o>p u>x), consonants b-m written as their rank 1-9 (b=1 c=2 d=3 f=4 g=5 h=6 k=7 l=8 m=9), n>o, p>cross-t, r>tau-t, s>d, t>c; words divided, cipher interspersed with clear Latin and German.

prior_solution.where: Butzmann's catalogue reports cipher on f. 59v without a reading; catalogue 3807 vetting (Codex, 23 Nov 2026) found no decipherment and tested no mapping.

conditions.human_role: Brice Dudout set the protocol and the order of work; AI agents transcribed (two blind passes and a blind arbiter), built the key, ran the pre-registered measure and read.
models: Claude Opus 5.5 (Anthropic), agents run by Brice Dudout

solution.what: Catalogue, leads, open pull requests and issues, our own folders, DECODE/Tomokiyo/Lasry (via the catalogue vetting): no earlier reading or reservation.
HAB full-resolution scans of 00119-00120 fetched for study (not distributed).
Two blind passes by separate agents with no key hypothesis, then a blind arbiter on 38 discrepancies; raw agreement 0.654 by letters.

Pattern words (bob = ana, opo = non) and alchemical vocabulary (luna, saturnus, venus, sigillum, capella) gave vowels shifted one place and consonants numbered by rank; key K1 built on lines L01-L18 only.

Pre-registered held-out test on L19-L46, freeze posted on #1023 before the measure: lexicon agreement 0.406 vs best of 200 permuted-key controls 0.035; criterion >= 0.503 (0.85 x calibration 0.592 on the key portion) and >= control + 0.30 not met. Found after the measure: the frozen groups.py also parsed the arbitration table, double-counting groups (315 letters instead of 272, below the 300 required); body only, post hoc, 0.452 vs 0.040.

Whole page read by sense with K1 after the measure (reading.md, reading.tsv): 125 of 171 cipher words sure, 21 probable, 9 restored, 16 unresolved. The held-out lines read as Latin and German (pro centenario viginti octo librae; treibscherben lavare; vitri), a post hoc observation, not a validation.

validation.notes: Pre-registered held-out test (freeze be7b18a1, issue #1023): 0.406 < 0.503, best control 0.035. Groups double-counted by a bug in the frozen groups.py (declared after the measure). Portion burnt; key not validated.

outcome.method_basis: Key rebuilt from the cipher of the page itself, with the clear Latin and German around it as context; no key, gloss or clear copy found.
outcome.fraction_read_source: reading.tsv: 125 sure of 171 cipher words; with probables 146 (0.854), with restorations 155 (0.906). Weight sigils and clear cursive words not counted.

credits.note: Two blind transcriptions and a blind arbiter; key recovered; held-out test failed; page read in part

gaps.detail: No fresh held-out portion: Butzmann reports cipher in earlier recipes of the volume, not yet located on the scans; a new freeze with a corrected groups.py and an enriched lexicon would be needed.

dpecf9, d+p8kbdbfe, bcfrff, kxbf, tf_, 2pH, 6fe, tf3xxk, tkk, d268k25c, qxt, cf, +br, fer, 8+, 8kof: no word with K1, probably single misread signs; a blind sign sheet (q / 4-shaped q / z / 2) could settle some.

texts.label: f. 59v, ciphered recipe (silver, lead, antimony, cupels)
texts.summary: A metallurgical recipe: silver (luna) refined with lead (saturnus), antimony, copper and iron scale, cupels and cupellation shards (Treibscherben), litharge and glass; a yield per hundredweight (twenty-eight pounds and four lot); wash only the shards and keep the slag. 125 of 171 cipher words sure.

reading_review.by: Claude Opus 5.5 agent for Brice Dudout (project); not a person
reading_review.note: Decryption made from key.tsv and the arbitrated transcription; read as sentences in reading.md and translation.md. Latin with German words, consistent vocabulary across the page (saturnus 9, luna 9, anthimonium 6, rex 6). Grade B: read in part, several abbreviations and 16 unresolved words; the key failed the pre-registered held-out bar (0.406 < 0.503). Not checked by a person.
